name: Flex Import
author: flextheme

sections.description:
Flex Import is a powerful demo importer plugin designed to simplify and accelerate your website setup experience. Created by the team at Flex Theme, this plugin seamlessly integrates with your Flex Theme subscription, giving you access to a library of high-quality templates and widgets for various industries. With Flex Import, setting up your website is as easy as a single click. It allows you to install demo content, required plugins, and customizations in a matter of seconds, so you can get your site up and running quickly and efficiently.

Flex Import comes equipped with an intuitive dashboard that brings all your templates, recommended plugins, and widgets into one easy-to-navigate space within WordPress. Perfect for both beginners and experienced WordPress users, Flex Import ensures that all components of your website are optimized for Elementor and compatible with the latest WordPress standards.

Key Features

  • One-Click Demo Import: Instantly set up your website with ready-made demo content that includes pages, layouts, and pre-configured settings.

  • Easy Plugin Installation: Automatically install and activate all recommended plugins necessary for your Flex Theme, streamlining your website setup process.

  • Comprehensive Dashboard: Access templates, widgets, support resources, and subscription information from a centralized plugin dashboard.

  • Automatic Template Updates: Ensure your templates are always up-to-date with the latest designs, performance optimizations, and compatibility adjustments.

  • Access to Free & Premium Widgets: Use a wide selection of widgets to customize and enhance your website’s functionality and visual appeal.

  • 24/7 Support Integration: Quickly connect with our support team directly from the dashboard for assistance whenever you need it.

  • Flexible Subscription Management: View and manage your Flex Theme subscription, including renewal reminders and upgrade options, all from within WordPress.

  • Responsive and Optimized: Designed to work seamlessly on any device, Flex Import ensures your site looks and functions beautifully on both desktop and mobile.

Get started with Flex Import and experience the quickest, easiest way to set up a stunning website with the power of Flex Theme.

External services

This plugin integrates with our server’s API to provide seamless JSON-based data communication. Additionally, it includes a demo import feature that fetches and writes pre-coded demo files directly to your WordPress installation for a smooth setup experience.

The server API and demo import are utilized to enhance the functionality of your WordPress site by automating data handling and demo content integration. All data interactions are secure and comply with standard best practices.

This service is provided by “Flextheme”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload via WordPress Admin

o Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
o Search for Flex Import and click Install Now.
o Once installed, click Activate to enable the plugin.

2. Manual Upload
o Download the Flex Import plugin zip file from the WordPress.org repository.
o In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
o Choose the flex-import.zip file, click Install Now, and then Activate.

3. Using Flex Import
o Upon activation, you will be prompted to install the Flex Theme. If you haven’t installed it yet, follow the on-screen instructions.
o After theme installation, open the Flex Import Dashboard from your WordPress menu.
o Browse available templates, plugins, and widgets, and select the demo content you wish to import.
o Click Import Demo and let Flex Import handle the rest. Your site will be populated with demo content, settings, and required plugins within moments.
